messages:
Ivy (CS): Heads-up — Marigold Health renewal in ~6w. Usage down ~50% over last 2w and they filed a ticket about intermittent 5xxs and truncated chat replies on their staging cluster. Procurement asked for a short reliability + cost note for their RFP. :warning:
Zack (Solutions): Any sample logs or endpoints called out?
Ivy (CS): They flagged /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings. Sample from their bundle:
```
2026-03-10T13:12:04Z 500 generation kv_cache_miss latency=2.4s req=mg-88
2026-03-10T13:17:22Z 502 batch_timeout batch_size=1
```
Mina (Eng): Pattern = bursty tiny requests -> batch collapse -> KV cold churn. Likely tail latency. I can run a quick replay on staging to confirm. ETA ~3h.
Rory (AE): Procurement likely comparing us to NimbusAI. They want p50/p95 and a mitigation plan. Recommend offering a 2-week dedicated routing trial instead of a straight discount.
Zack (Solutions): Immediate playbook: 1) reproduce with their traces; 2) offer temporary dedicated routing during their evaluation window; 3) send a 1-page exec summary for procurement + a short ops checklist for their engineer. I'll draft the docs.
Ivy (CS): New procurement contact is K. Patel (non-technical). Their ML lead recently left, so docs need to be procurement-friendly.
Mina (Eng): If we confirm batch timeouts, quick config: lower tenant max_wait_ms to 20ms and bump tenant concurrency cap. I'll capture before/after p50/p95.
sync-bot: Meeting proposed: Marigold procurement + CS + AE — tomorrow 10:00 PT. Invite sent.
Rory (AE): I'll ask if they have an RFP scoring sheet and whether Nimbus is in their shortlist. Push trial > discount.
Zack (Solutions): Action items: Zack - draft exec + ops pages (owner: Zack) EOD; Mina - reproduce + logs + config patch (owner: Mina) in 3h; Rory - confirm competitive set & procurement asks (owner: Rory) before meeting; Ivy - consolidate support examples and run invite (owner: Ivy).
Ivy (CS): If anyone sees truncated response examples in the ticket, paste them here. Could be early stream termination.
Mina (Eng): Noted. If we need live debug, ask them to capture curl + headers during the 13:00-13:30 PT window.
Ivy (CS): Thanks team — will update after the call. :pray:
